create_inferer_context: create an InfererContext from a BPState to initialize belief propagation inference
run_inferer_update: run the InfererContext update method to update log potentials, factor-to-vertex messages, and evidence
get_inferer_beliefs: get beliefs from a BPArrays using the InfererContext get_beliefs method
decode_map_states: decode MAP states from beliefs dictionary using the decode_map_states function
unflatten_beliefs: unflatten a flat beliefs array into per-variable-group belief dictionaries
